caption: A cloud slides across the sun over a picnic table, and the whole scene dims.

sa.check: A picnic table is in sunlight.
A cloud slides across the sun.
Sharp shadows soften as the cloud moves in.

pc.expect: The dimming affects everything at once and the sharp shadows soften.
pc.fail: Only part of the scene dims; or the shadows stay sharp; or the scene brightens.

pc.expect: The dimming is gradual and follows the cloud.
pc.fail: It is instant; or it flickers; or it brightens while the cloud still covers the sun.

pc.expect: The cloud moves steadily and nothing on the table moves.
pc.fail: The cloud jumps; or objects on the table move; or the shadows swing round.

pc.expect: Colours stay the same, only dimmer.
pc.fail: Objects change colour; or the grass changes colour; or the sky changes abruptly.
An object vanishes; or appears; or the table duplicates.

pc.expect: The table setting stays the same.
pc.fail: Items rearrange; or the table changes; or the surroundings change.
